archive_frequency: Daily at 04:00 UTC with up to five-minute jitter. The job requires the declared archive mount, budget and 400 GiB reserve, waits for 60 continuous seconds below 2% full I/O PSI in active MIDAS service cgroups (including the protected recorder), and rechecks before every segment and replay segment. Host-wide PSI is advisory because unrelated services can dominate it. Missing protected-service telemetry fails closed. Each safe-window wait fails closed after three hours; the complete operation has a separate six-hour bound. No hard I/O bandwidth controller is available. Keep the timer disabled until the initial full copy/replay manifest and its incremental baseline are verified.
derivative_pruning: Only deploy/reality-research.json scheduled completed example caches and unpublished builder scratch are disposable. Keep immutable manifests/code/source references and visible pruning receipts. Raw roots, accepted Gate B/C/D artifacts and protected Prometheus evidence are excluded.
offloading: Verified local archive on the allocated /dev/sda4 staging filesystem; this is a second copy, not off-host redundancy. Never delete originals automatically.
rollover: A new raw root requires an intentional collector stop, finalized verified archive, retained old-root manifest, and reviewed disk commitments. Keep the original root recoverable; new root identity/ordinals must remain distinct. No automatic rollover is configured.
on_exhaustion: Fail closed, publish FAILED status if disk permits, retain complete checksummed observations, require operator capacity action. Do not drop frames or erase observations to maintain an apparently healthy state.
headroom_basis: Separate commitments: raw budget up to 112 GiB on NVMe while preserving at least 20 GiB filesystem free; verified archive budget up to 112 GiB on /dev/sda4 while preserving 400 GiB. At the 2026-10-21 06:19 CEST snapshot, raw usage was 4,773,485,393 B and NVMe free space 176,480,464,896 B. Filling the remaining raw budget would leave about 60.99 GB free, including the protected 20 GiB reserve and about 39.52 GB of additional headroom. HDD free space was 641,197,764,608 B; filling the archive budget while preserving 400 GiB leaves about 91.44 GB of additional headroom before archive population. The existing local archive remains preserved.
research_priority: Collector: 896 MiB MemoryHigh, 1 GiB MemoryMax, zero swap, 25% of one CPU. Capacity monitor: 128 MiB, 10% CPU. Archive: 640 MiB MemoryHigh, 768 MiB MemoryMax, zero swap, up to one CPU, Nice 15 and idle I/O scheduling class. User cgroups do not expose io.max; idle I/O class is not a hard throughput guarantee.
limits: At the conservative 973,161,695 B/day rate, 112 GiB from the current raw usage provides about 118.7 days of byte-budget runway. The 105-day age stop is expected about 98 days from the oldest retained record, leaving roughly 20 days of byte-budget margin; originals are retained and collection stops instead of pruning.

The 112 GiB raw allocation supports a bounded initial workload only: approximately 1.21x the conservative current growth rate through the remaining ~98-day age horizon. At that point the 20 GiB filesystem reserve remains protected with about 59 GB of additional free space at the latest measured baseline. A 2x sustained workload is not supported for 90 days on current NVMe capacity.
Local replication is not off-host redundancy.

The protected recorder still enforces its currently loaded 24 GiB budget and 90-day retention until an explicitly approved restart; the 112 GiB / 100-day config is pending and must be shown separately by monitoring.
No raw pruning, automatic rollover, or new collectors are configured. Sustained operation beyond the age stop requires an intentional reviewed root rollover.
Capacity monitor samples every 30 minutes; it warns at 30 days, marks critical at 14 days, and requires capacity action by 7 days without pruning raw data.

The user service cgroup has no I/O controller, so archival throughput cannot be capped with io.max. The archive gates on active MIDAS service I/O-full PSI at 2% avg10/avg60, waits for a 60-second quiet window, and rechecks between copy/replay segments. Host-wide PSI is advisory; service attribution found netdata.service contributing 1.47% avg10 while the recorder cgroup was at 0.20% avg10, and sampled NVMe/HDD utilization was below 25%. Each admission wait has a three-hour limit and the full operation has a separate six-hour maximum. The first attempt reached 11.82% host avg10 and was safely interrupted before a manifest was published. Keep the timer disabled until the bounded initial archive and incremental baseline are validated.
